description: Cards with a quantity field and an add button, under a live cart count.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Dishes added to the cart from the card: the live cart count over a grid of cards, each with a picture, name,
  weight, price and a quantity field named after the dish beside the add button. Axes: media (image, none),
  tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Dish, FoodLabels } from "./dish-showcase.types";

  export type DishCartGridProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    dishes: Dish[];
    empty?: string;
    labels: FoodLabels;
    count?: number;
    media?: "image" | "none";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Grid from "../compose/Grid.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import AddQty from "../components/add-qty.svelte";
  import CartCount from "../components/cart-count.svelte";
  import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    dishes,
    empty = "",
    labels,
    count = 0,
    media = "image",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: DishCartGridProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} lead={lead} tone={tone} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  {#if ((dishes?.length ?? 0) === 0)}
    <EmptyState icon="shopping-bag" title={empty} />
  {:else}
    <Stack gap="4" align="stretch">
      <Group justify="end">
        <CartCount count={count} label={labels.inCart} />
      </Group>
      <Grid cols="1-3" class="gap-4" data-slot="items">
        {#each dishes as d (d.id)}
          <Stack gap="4" class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border overflow-hidden pb-4" data-slot="item">
            {#if ((media as string) === "image")}
              <MediaFrame alt={d.name} />
            {/if}
            <Stack gap="2" class={(((media as string) === "image") ? "px-4" : "px-4 pt-4")}>
              <Group gap="2" align="baseline" justify="between">
                <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
                  {d.name}
                </Text>
                <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
                  {d.weight}
                </Text>
              </Group>
              <Text size="lg" weight="bold">
                {fmtMoney(d.price, d.currency)}
              </Text>
            </Stack>
            <Box class="px-4">
              <AddQty name={tpl("{0}-qty-{1}", id, d.id)} dish={d.name} labels={labels} />
            </Box>
          </Stack>
        {/each}
      </Grid>
    </Stack>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
